1582073522763223040 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 7
1. Again, being comfortable is comforting --and hot! (Being tense and hurried is not).

2. Being palpably wanted is hot and validating for your partner --provided they aren't worried about having to slow you down, or push you off.

Be a tease! Make 'em wait! Make 'em beg!
↓
1582075617410809856 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 5
3. Eliciting sexual pleasure requires and benefits from >90% less force, vigor, and movement than commonly thought / depicted in porn.

Leaning into the bliss of every single touch can playfully attune you to those subtleties, rhythms, and responses.

(Drugs can help teach this).
↓
1582078713998741505 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 3
I'm NOT claiming that orgasms can't be brute-forced. They often can: 

The Hitachi Magic Wand is popular for a reason. Some women can get off on a intense g-spot stimulation. But:

Subtle attunement is unsubtly more powerful, more fun, more generally applicable --and less common.
↓
1582081880802721792 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 4
Subtle attunement to a person begins with clothes on, even just co-existing in the same space, as you appreciate their presence in your open awareness.

Notice what that that presence feels like. Take it from an autist: this is how we learn to intuit non-verbal cues.
↓
1582083640879505408 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 3
Subtle attunement is how we make a move without being weird.

Sure, you CAN count the number of times she touches her hair like a PUA, or do the autistic, "Are you attracted to me / can I kiss you".

But this is rarely optimal: both take one out of the present shared 'we-space'.
↓
1582085629995003904 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 1
Guessing and going for it (a hug, a kiss, whatever) is even more strongly contraindicated, obviously.

Best case, you guess right and it lands OK, but isn't as good as it could be. 

Worst case, you traumatize someone, land in a call-out post, and/or get charged with assault.
↓
1582086495975854081 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 3
Many people think these are the only two options. 

They're not. Take a first kiss:

If you are being present with someone, and tuned into their emotional state, body language, etc. you can learn to sense moments to *slowly* lean in for a kiss.
↓
1582087439845588993 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 2
'Slowly' is critical here: you want the other person to savor the anticipation --and have the space and opportunity to lean away in the event you misjudge.

The latter also implies you must not put your hand on the back of their head!
↓
1582088882807414784 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 6
Staying present, with open awareness and building desire, also lets you enjoy kissing. 

And light touch. And massage --blissing out on exploring your partner's musculature.

Every minute (hour) you spend savoring your partner lends them license to unreservedly desire you more.
↓
1582093631439003649 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 2
On massage:

1. How would I like my back rubbed? <- fairly reliable heuristic / point of departure.

2. Think gloves, not mittens: each finger is a distinct pleasure purveying implement! This cannot be overstated.

3. Momentary back-rubs can go great with hugs, even platonically.
↓
1582097177111035904 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 2 [(SEED) type=semantic_search]
4. There is a cringe beta massage guy thing to avoid being.

It's hard for me to parse out what makes this distinct, but I think it's something like not being honest about one's intent.

I'm more blissfully vocal while giving massages than most men are while literally cumming.
↓
1582101250010943489 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 3
On vocalization: 

Provided one is savoring every moment and proceeding slowly: guttural groans, moans, even wimpers are good for ~everyone: embodying for you, validating for them.

The only exception I've encountered (~2%) was *extremely* traumatized and otherwise unsafe.
↓
1582102546185084929 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 1
Vocalization, cont'd:

How verbal ought one be?

This is higher variance than non-lexical sounds. Statistically, nerdier people want more talk, sometimes continuous narration. Normies, less. 

As with most things, you can try a bit and see how it lands, or find a sexy way to ask.
↓
1582107982904823808 [2022-10-17] @georgejrjrjr 💜 2
Vocalization cont’d (3/3):

It only works when it is sincerely felt. 

(uh, unless you’re dating a porn addict, maybe, but I don’t recommend that).

Lean in, bliss out, make a joyful noise —don’t front.
